title: Limit of the right side: difference quotients of a C^1_c map against g
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U ⊆ R^n open, zeta : R^n -> R^l a C^1 map with compact support and tsupport zeta ⊆ U, g : R^n -> R^l continuous on U, and e in R^n. Then ∫_U <h^{-1}(zeta(x) - zeta(x - he)), g(x)> dx -> ∫_U <Dzeta(x)e, g(x)> dx as h -> 0 with h ≠ 0 (along 𝓝[≠] 0), where Dzeta(x)e := fderiv R zeta x e.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (ζ g : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ContinuousOn g U → Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => ∫ x in U, inner ℝ (h⁻¹ • (ζ x - ζ (x - h • e))) (g x)) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (∫ x in U, inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ ζ x e) (g x)))
